about_the_game:
What is Star Catcher?

We are The Fallow. A herbivorous and peaceful people. We have a duty: to be stewards of this sea and to free the souls lost within it. They are the scattered star-lights in the sea and the sky. We free the souls by guiding them and offering passage to the gate at the centre of our world.

MAIN FEATURES

Fish for Lost Souls!

Fish up lost souls by casting your rod into the sea of stars. The types of souls you catch and how you catch them are impacted by the parts of your rod that you have unlocked and equipped - as well as where you choose to fish. When a soul is guided to your lure, complete a fun fishing minigame to collect them.

Explore an Archipelago Lost to Time

Travelling either by hoof or by sea to discover new areas, environments and fishing spots. New paths will unlock for you as you release more souls, and you might find unique hidden areas by keeping a keen eye out on your journey.

Sail Alone or With Others!

Bring your friends with you on your exploration of the cosmos! Catch souls together, show off your signature style, and explore using the unique mechanics that emerge when two or more fallow work together.

Grow the World Alongside You

Release the souls you catch at the Soul Gate in order to receive pearls. As you release more souls to the gates, your environment will change. Then, you'll gain access to new areas, new NPC's and new souls. You'll be able to gift your pearls to NPC's you find along the way.

Build A Reputation 

Increase your reputation among Fallow by offering them your pearls. Fallow may offer you new fishing gear, furniture, information and customisation options as you improve your relations with them and grow closer, together.

Customise Your Appearance!

Express yourself by fully customising your playthrough! Alter your character appearance or ship by unlocking and equipping different skin or clothing options; then build and customise your own personal room within the ship by collecting different furniture items!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel i7 7800k or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Star Catcher is a multiplayer fishing sandbox where you play as an adrift fisherman sailing across a sea of stars. Within this beautiful and ancient world, you must explore, discover and fish up lost souls so that may guide them to gates where you will send them away.
